used_notes: Raw notes critically changed judgment: statistics alone would flag C-42, C-24, C-40, C-23, C-48 as genuine based on 3-4 events and 9-11 origins, but note analysis revealed they lack true causal completeness (missing key early-chain events) and geographic clustering (single-region repetition patterns). Conversely, C-57, C-11, C-6 appeared borderline on statistics but notes confirm independent multi-region reporting of sequential causal events. Notes also exposed single-site operational noise masking as risk in lower-ranking candidates.
reasoning_notes: Genuine risks selected by: (1) 4+ events from single causal chain in logical+temporal order with 10+ independent sources, OR (2) 3+ events with 8+ independent sources AND 10+ geographically diverse organizational origins. Top tier (C-9: arbor-na, C-58: zephyr-core495, C-39: nimbusx532) represent complete 5-6 event chains with 10-12 distinct regions reporting independently. Mid tier (C-12, C-28, C-20, C-41, C-7) show 4-5 events in causal order with 9-12 diverse origins. Excluded C-5, C-3, C-49: chain broken (missing critical link), <3 sources. Artifact filtering prevented counting as genuine the low-diversity candidates where single-site or single-team noise created apparent chains.
